constellation.tr: 使另一名玩家抽{Cards:diff()}张牌，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}，并获得{Block:diff()} 点[gold]格挡[/gold]

consuming shadow.name: 吞噬暗影
consuming shadow.en:
[gold]Channel[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Dark[/gold].
At the end of your turn, [gold]Evoke[/gold] your leftmost Orb.
consuming shadow.tr:
[gold]生成[/gold]{Repeat:diff()}个[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球。
在你的回合结束时，[gold]激发[/gold]你最左侧的充能球。

convergence.name: 汇流
convergence.en:
Next turn,
gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and {Stars:starIcons()}.
[gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn.
convergence.tr:
在本回合[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。
在下个回合，
获得{Energy:energyIcons()}与{Stars:starIcons()}。

coolant.name: 冷却剂
coolant.en: At the start of your turn, gain {CoolantPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each unique Orb you have.
coolant.tr: 在你的回合开始时，你每有一种不同的充能球，就获得{CoolantPower:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

coolheaded.name: 冷静头脑
coolheaded.tr:
[gold]生成[/gold]1个[gold]冰霜[/gold]充能球。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

coordinate.name: 协同配合
coordinate.tr: 在本回合给予其他玩家{StrengthPower:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

corrosive wave.name: 腐蚀波
corrosive wave.en: Whenever you draw a card this turn, apply {CorrosiveWave:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
corrosive wave.tr: 打出此牌后，你在本回合每抽到一张牌，就给予所有敌人{CorrosiveWave:diff()}层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

corruption.name: 腐化
corruption.en:
Skills cost 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
Whenever you play a Skill, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
corruption.tr:
技能牌消耗变为0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。
每当你打出一张技能牌时，将其[gold]消耗[/gold]。

cosmic indifference.name: 宇宙冷漠
cosmic indifference.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
cosmic indifference.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
将[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]中的一张牌放到你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]的顶部。

countdown.name: 倒数计时
countdown.en: At the start of your turn, apply {CountdownPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to a random enemy.
countdown.tr: 在你的回合开始时，给予随机敌人{CountdownPower:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。

crash landing.name: 迫降
crash landing.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Fill your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [gold]Debris[/gold].
crash landing.tr:
对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
用[gold]碎屑[/gold]填满你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

creative ai.name: 创造性AI
creative ai.en: At the start of your turn, add a random Power into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
creative ai.tr: 在你的回合开始时，将一张随机能力牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

crescent spear.name: 新月长矛
crescent spear.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for ALL your cards that have a {singleStarIcon} cost.
crescent spear.tr:
造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。
你每有一张拥有{singleStarIcon}耗能的卡牌，这张牌就额外造成{ExtraDamage:diff()}点伤害。

crimson mantle.name: 绯红披风
crimson mantle.en: At the start of your turn, lose 1 HP and gain {CrimsonMantlePower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
crimson mantle.tr: 在你的回合开始时，失去1点生命并获得{CrimsonMantlePower:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

cruelty.name: 残酷
cruelty.tr: 有[gold]易伤[/gold]状态的敌人额外受到{CrueltyPower:diff()}%的伤害。

crush under.name: 下砸
crush under.en: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. All enemies lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
crush under.tr: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。所有敌人在本回合失去{StrengthLoss:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

dagger spray.name: 匕首雨
dagger spray.en: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice.
dagger spray.tr: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害两次。

dagger throw.name: 投掷匕首
dagger throw.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw 1 card.
Discard 1 card.
dagger throw.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
抽1张牌。
丢弃1张牌。

danse macabre.name: 死亡之舞
danse macabre.en: Whenever you play a card that costs {Energy:energyIcons()} or more, gain {DanseMacabrePower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
danse macabre.tr: 每当你打出一张耗能大于等于{Energy:energyIcons()}的牌时，获得{DanseMacabrePower:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

darkness.name: 漆黑
darkness.en:
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Dark[/gold].
Trigger the passive ability of all [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs{IfUpgraded:show: twice|}.
darkness.tr:
[gold]生成[/gold]1[gold]个黑暗[/gold]充能球。
触发所有[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球的被动{IfUpgraded:show:两次|}。

dark embrace.name: 黑暗之拥
dark embrace.en:
Whenever a card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold],
draw 1 card.
dark embrace.tr:
每当有一张牌被[gold]消耗[/gold]时，
抽1张牌。

dark shackles.name: 黑暗镣铐
dark shackles.tr: 使一名敌人在本回合失去{StrengthLoss:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

dash.name: 冲刺
dash.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

deathbringer.name: 死亡使者
deathbringer.tr: 给予所有敌人{DoomPower:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]和{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

death's door.name: 死亡之门
death's door.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you applied [gold]Doom[/gold] this turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} additional {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
death's door.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
如果你在本回合中曾给予过[gold]灾厄[/gold]，则额外获得{Repeat:diff()}次[gold]格挡[/gold]。

death march.name: 死亡行军
death march.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card drawn during your turn.
death march.tr:
造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。
你在回合进行中每抽到一张牌，都会使其额外造成{ExtraDamage:diff()}点伤害。

debilitate.name: 摧残
debilitate.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective against the enemy for the next {DebilitatePower:diff()} {DebilitatePower:plural:turn|turns}.
debilitate.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
在接下来的{DebilitatePower:diff()}回合内，该敌人身上的[gold]易伤[/gold]与[gold]虚弱[/gold]效果翻倍。

debt.name: 债务
debt.en: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
debt.tr: 在你的回合结束时，如果这张牌在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中，你失去{Gold:diff()}[gold]金币[/gold]。

decay.name: 腐朽
decay.en: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], take {Damage:diff()} damage.
decay.tr: 在你的回合结束时，如果这张牌在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中, 你受到{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

decisions, decisions.name: 抉择，抉择
decisions, decisions.en:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Choose a Skill in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and play it {Repeat:diff()} times.
decisions, decisions.tr:
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
选择你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的一张技能牌，并将其打出{Repeat:diff()}次。

defy.name: 违逆
defy.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

delay.name: 拖延
delay.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
在下个回合，
获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

demesne.name: 领域
demesne.en: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
demesne.tr: 在你的回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并额外多抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

demonic shield.name: 恶魔护盾

demon form.name: 恶魔形态
demon form.en: At the start of your turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
demon form.tr: 在你的回合开始时，获得{StrengthPower:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

deprecated card.name: 弃用卡牌
deprecated card.en:
[blue]This card was removed in a recent update.[/blue]
Draw 1 card.
Remove this from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
deprecated card.tr:
[blue]这张卡牌在近期的一次更新中被移除。[/blue]
抽1张牌。
将这张牌从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除。

despair.name: 绝望
despair.tr: 你每给予1层[gold]灾厄[/gold]，就获得1点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

devour life.name: 吞噬生命
devour life.tr: 每当你打出一张[gold]灵魂[/gold]时，[gold]召唤[/gold]{DevourLifePower:diff()}。

dirge.name: 挽歌
dirge.en:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()} X times.
Add X [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Souls+|Souls}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
dirge.tr:
[gold]召唤[/gold]{Summon:diff()}X次。
将X张[gold]{IfUpgraded:show:灵魂+|灵魂}[/gold]添加到你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中。

discovery.name: 发现
discovery.en: Choose 1 of 3 random cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
discovery.tr: 从3张随机牌中选择1张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

disintegration.name: 瓦解
disintegration.en: At the end of your turn, take {DisintegrationPower:diff()} damage.
disintegration.tr: 在你的回合结束时，受到{DisintegrationPower:diff()}点伤害。

dismantle.name: 拆卸
dismantle.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy is [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], hits twice.
dismantle.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
如果该敌人有[gold]易伤[/gold]状态，则攻击两次。

distraction.name: 声东击西
distraction.en: Add a random Skill into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
distraction.tr: 将一张随机技能牌添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中。这张牌在本回合内可以免费打出。

dodge and roll.name: 闪躲翻滚
dodge and roll.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
在下个回合，获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

dominate.name: 主宰
dominate.en:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Gain {StrengthPerVulnerable:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] on the enemy.
dominate.tr:
给予{VulnerablePower:diff()}层[gold]易伤[/gold]。
敌人身上每有一层[gold]易伤[/gold]，就获得{StrengthPerVulnerable:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

doubt.name: 疑虑
doubt.en: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
doubt.tr: 在你的回合结束时，如果这张牌在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中，获得{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

dowsing.name: 探寻
dowsing.en: After entering {Rooms:diff()} more [gold]?[/gold] {Rooms:plural:room|rooms}, transforms into an [gold]Abundance[/gold].
dowsing.tr: 在进入{Rooms:diff()}个[gold]?[/gold]{Rooms:plural:|}房间后，这张牌变化为[gold]富足[/gold]。

drain power.name: 能量汲取
drain power.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
drain power.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
随机[gold]升级[/gold]你[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]中的{Cards:diff()}张牌。

dramatic entrance.name: 闪亮登场
dramatic entrance.tr: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。

dredge.name: 清淤
dredge.en: Put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
dredge.tr: 将{Cards:diff()}张牌从[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

drum of battle.name: 战鼓
drum of battle.en:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
When this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
drum of battle.tr:
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
这张牌被[gold]消耗[/gold]时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

dualcast.name: 双重释放
dualcast.tr: [gold]激发[/gold]你最右侧的充能球两次。

dual wield.name: 双持
dual wield.en: Choose an Attack or Power card. Add {IfUpgraded:show:{Cards} copies|a copy} of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
dual wield.tr: 选择一张攻击牌或能力牌。将该牌的{IfUpgraded:show:{Cards}张复制品|一张复制品}加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

dying star.name: 星灭
dying star.en: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. ALL enemies lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
dying star.tr: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。所有敌人在本回合中失去{StrengthLoss:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

echoing slash.name: 回响斩击
echoing slash.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Repeat this effect for each enemy killed.
echoing slash.tr:
对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
每有一名敌人被击杀，就重复此效果。

echo form.name: 回响形态
echo form.en: The first card you play each turn is played an extra time.
echo form.tr: 你每回合打出的第一张牌会被打出两次。

eidolon.name: 幻景
eidolon.en: Play ALL [gold]Ethereal[/gold] cards in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
eidolon.tr: 打出你[gold]消耗牌堆[/gold]中的所有[gold]虚无[/gold]牌。

end of days.name: 末日降临
end of days.en:
Apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Kill enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP.
end of days.tr:
给予所有敌人{DoomPower:diff()}层[gold]灾厄[/gold]。
杀死所有[gold]灾厄[/gold]大于等于当前生命值的敌人。

enfeebling touch.name: 弱化之触
enfeebling touch.tr: 让一名敌人在本回合内失去{StrengthLoss:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。

enlightenment.name: 开悟
enlightenment.en: Reduce the cost of ALL cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to 1 this {IfUpgraded:show:combat|turn}.
enlightenment.tr: 在这{IfUpgraded:show:场战斗|个回合}，你当前[gold]手牌[/gold]中所有牌的耗能降低至1。

enthralled.name: 执迷
enthralled.en: If this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], it must be played before other cards.
enthralled.tr: 如果这张牌在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中，你必须优先打出这张牌。

entropy.name: 熵
entropy.en: At the start of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
entropy.tr: 在你的回合开始时，[gold]变化[/gold]你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的{Cards:diff()}张牌。

envenom.name: 涂毒
envenom.en: Whenever an Attack deals unblocked damage, apply {EnvenomPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
envenom.tr: 每有一次攻击造成未被格挡的伤害，就给予{EnvenomPower:diff()}层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

equilibrium.name: 均衡
equilibrium.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
在本回合[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

escape plan.name: 逃脱计划
escape plan.en:
Draw 1 card.
If you draw a Skill, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
escape plan.tr:
抽1张牌。
如果抽到的是技能牌，则获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

evil eye.name: 邪眼
evil eye.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain another {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] if you have [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card this turn.
evil eye.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
如果你在本回合[gold]消耗[/gold]过卡牌，则额外获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

expect a fight.name: 跃跃欲试
expect a fight.en:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gains {CalculationExtra:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Strength[/gold] you have.
expect a fight.tr:
获得{CalculatedBlock:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
你每拥有一点[gold]力量[/gold]，这张牌就额外获得{CalculationExtra:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

expertise.name: 独门技术
expertise.en:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
They gain [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
expertise.tr:
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
这些牌在本回合获得[gold]保留[/gold]。

expose.name: 暴露
expose.en:
Remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] from the enemy.
Apply {Power:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
expose.tr:
去除敌人身上的所有[gold]格挡[/gold]值和[gold]人工制品[/gold]。
并给予{Power:diff()}层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

exterminate.name: 杀灭
exterminate.en: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.

fade.name: 消影
fade.tr: 另一名玩家在本回合获得{DexterityPower:diff()}点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

falling star.name: 陨星
falling star.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。
给予{VulnerablePower:diff()}层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

fan of knives.name: 刀扇
fan of knives.en:
[gold]Shivs[/gold] now hit ALL enemies.
Add {Shivs:diff()} [gold]Shivs[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
fan of knives.tr:
[gold]小刀[/gold]现在会攻击所有敌人。
将{Shivs:diff()}张[gold]小刀[/gold]添加到你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

fasten.name: 勒紧
fasten.en: Gain an additional {ExtraBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] from Defend cards.
fasten.tr: 从“防御”牌中额外获得{ExtraBlock:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

fear.name: 恐惧
fear.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{VulnerablePower:diff()}层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

feed.name: 狂宴
feed.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
feed.tr:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
[gold]斩杀[/gold]时，永久获得{MaxHp:diff()}点最大生命值。

feel no pain.name: 无惧疼痛
feel no pain.tr: 每当有一张牌被[gold]消耗[/gold]时，获得{Power:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

feral.name: 野性
feral.en:
The first {FeralPower:plural:time|{FeralPower:diff()} times} you play a
0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} Attack each turn,
return it to your [gold]Hand[/gold].

fetch.name: 取回
fetch.en:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
If this is the first time this card has been played this turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
fetch.tr:
[gold]奥斯提[/gold]造成{OstyDamage:diff()}点伤害。
如果这是这张牌第一次在本回合被打出，则抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

fiend fire.name: 恶魔之焰
fiend fire.en:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].

获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

parry.name: 招架
parry.tr: [gold]君王之剑[/gold]现在能让你获得{ParryPower:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

particle wall.name: 粒子墙

Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
particle wall.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
将此牌返回你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

patter.name: 星星点点
patter.tr:
获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
获得{VigorPower:diff()}点[gold]活力[/gold]。

perfected strike.name: 完美打击

Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.

造成{CalculatedDamage:diff()}点伤害。

phantom blades.name: 幻影之刃

[gold]Shivs[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold].

photon cut.name: 光子切割

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

pillar of creation.name: 创世之柱

plot.name: 筹划

pommel strike.name: 剑柄打击

delicate frond.name: 娇嫩蕨草
delicate frond.en: At the start of each combat, fill all empty potion slots with random [gold]Potions[/gold].
delicate frond.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，用随机[gold]药水[/gold]将你的空药水栏位填满。

demon tongue.name: 恶魔之舌
demon tongue.en: The first time you lose HP on your turn, heal HP equal to the amount lost.
demon tongue.tr: 每回合第一次在回合内失去生命值时，回复等量的生命值。

deprecated relic.name: 弃用遗物
deprecated relic.en: This relic is no longer in the game. It's just here for legacy purposes.
deprecated relic.tr: 这件遗物已经从游戏中被移除。它在这里仅做纪念意义。

diamond diadem.name: 钻石头冠
diamond diadem.en: Start combat with [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Your [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn.
diamond diadem.tr: 战斗开始时获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。你的[gold]格挡[/gold]不会在你的[blue]第2[/blue]回合开始前被移除。

dingy rug.name: 肮脏地毯
dingy rug.en: Card rewards can now contain Colorless cards.
dingy rug.tr: 卡牌奖励现在会包括无色牌。

distinguished cape.name: 卓越斗篷
distinguished cape.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Curses}[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red] and [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Apparition|Apparitions}[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
distinguished cape.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]{Curses}[/blue]张随机[red]诅咒[/red]牌和[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]灵体[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

divine destiny.name: 天命所归
divine destiny.en: At the start of each combat, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
divine destiny.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得{Stars:starIcons()}。

divine right.name: 天赋君权
divine right.en: At the start of each combat, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
divine right.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得{Stars:starIcons()}。

dolly's mirror.name: 多利之镜
dolly's mirror.en: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
dolly's mirror.tr: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择一张牌进行复制。

dowsing rod.name: 寻龙尺
dowsing rod.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]探寻[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

dragon fruit.name: 火龙果
dragon fruit.en: Whenever you gain [gold]Gold[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
dragon fruit.tr: 每当你获得[gold]金币[/gold]时，提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点你的最大生命值。

dream catcher.name: 捕梦网
dream catcher.en: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], you may add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
dream catcher.tr: 每当你[gold]休息[/gold]时，可以添加一张牌到你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

driftwood.name: 浮木
driftwood.en: You may reroll each card reward once.
driftwood.tr: 你可以在每一个卡牌奖励中重掷一次。

ectoplasm.name: 灵体外质
ectoplasm.en: You can no longer gain [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
ectoplasm.tr: 你不能再获得任何[gold]金币[/gold]。在回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}

electric shrymp.name: 放电异虾
electric shrymp.tr: 拾起时，选择一张技能牌为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]注能[/purple]。

ember tea.name: 余烬茶
ember tea.en: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
ember tea.tr: 在接下来的[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

emotion chip.name: 情感芯片
emotion chip.en: If you lost HP during the previous turn, trigger the passive ability of all Orbs at the start of your turn.
emotion chip.tr: 在每回合开始时，如果你在之前回合受到过伤害，则触发所有充能球的被动效果。

empty cage.name: 空鸟笼
empty cage.tr: 拾起时，选择移除[gold]牌组[/gold]中的[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

endless appetite.name: 无尽食欲
endless appetite.tr: 每当你[gold]消耗[/gold]一张牌时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

eternal feather.name: 永恒羽毛
eternal feather.en: For every {Cards:plural:card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
eternal feather.tr: 你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中每有[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌，当你进入[gold]休息处[/gold]时就会回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

anchor???.name: 锚？？？
anchor???.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

blood vial???.name: 小血瓶？？？
blood vial???.en: At the start of each combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
blood vial???.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

lee's waffle???.name: 李家华夫饼？？？
lee's waffle???.en: Upon pickup, heal [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your HP.
lee's waffle???.tr: 拾起时，回复你[green]{Heal}%[/green]的生命值。

mango???.name: 芒果？？？
mango???.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
mango???.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

the merchant's rug???.name: 商人的地毯？？？
the merchant's rug???.tr: 低劣的仿制品。没有任何作用。

orichalcum???.name: 奥利哈钢？？？
orichalcum???.en: If you end your turn without [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
orichalcum???.tr: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何[gold]格挡[/gold]，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

snecko eye???.name: 异蛇之眼？？？
snecko eye???.tr: 每场战斗开始时获得[red]混乱[/red]效果。

strike dummy???.name: 打击木偶？？？
strike dummy???.tr: 名字中有“打击”的卡牌造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点额外伤害。

venerable tea set???.name: 古茶具套装？？？
venerable tea set???.en: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
venerable tea set???.tr: 到达[gold]休息处[/gold]后的下一场战斗开始时额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

fencing manual.name: 击剑指南
fencing manual.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Forge[/gold] [blue]{Forge}[/blue].

festive popper.name: 节日拉炮
festive popper.en: At the start of each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
festive popper.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

fiddle.name: 小提琴
fiddle.en: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}. You may not draw cards during your turn.
fiddle.tr: 在每个回合开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。你在回合进行中不再能抽任何牌。

fishing rod.name: 钓鱼竿
fishing rod.en: Every {Combats:plural:normal combat|[blue]{}[/blue] normal combats}, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
fishing rod.tr: 每[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场普通战斗，随机[gold]升级[/gold]你[gold]牌组[/gold]中的一张牌。

forgotten soul.name: 遗忘之魂
forgotten soul.en: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
forgotten soul.tr: 每当你[gold]消耗[/gold]一张牌，随机对一名敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

fragrant mushroom.name: 芳香蘑菇
fragrant mushroom.en: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
fragrant mushroom.tr: 拾起时，失去[blue]{HpLoss}[/blue]点生命，然后随机[gold]升级[/gold][blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

fresnel lens.name: 菲涅耳透镜
fresnel lens.en: Whenever you add a card that gains [gold]Block[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]Nimble[/purple] [blue]{NimbleAmount}[/blue].
fresnel lens.tr: 每当你将一张带有[gold]格挡[/gold]的牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]时，为那张牌[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]灵巧[/purple][blue]{NimbleAmount}[/blue]

frozen egg.name: 冻结之蛋
frozen egg.en: Whenever you add a Power into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
frozen egg.tr: 每当你获得能力牌时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

funerary mask.name: 葬礼面具
funerary mask.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Soul|Souls}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
funerary mask.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]灵魂[/gold]加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

fur coat.name: 皮草大衣
fur coat.en: Upon pickup, mark [blue]{Combats}[/blue] random combats. Enemies in those rooms have [blue]1[/blue] HP.
fur coat.tr: 拾起时，随机标记[blue]{Combats}[/blue]处战斗。这些战斗中的敌人将只有[blue]1[/blue]点生命。

gambling chip.name: 赌博筹码
gambling chip.en: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards then draw that many.
gambling chip.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，丢弃任意张牌，然后抽相同数量张牌。

game piece.name: 棋子
game piece.en: Whenever you play a Power, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
game piece.tr: 每当你打出能力牌时，抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

girya.name: 壶铃
girya.en: You can now gain [gold]Strength[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]. ([blue]3[/blue] times max)
girya.tr: 你现在能在[gold]休息处[/gold]获得[gold]力量[/gold]。（最多[blue]3[/blue]次）

glass eye.name: 玻璃眼珠
glass eye.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Common[/gold] cards, [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Uncommon[/gold] cards, and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] card.
glass eye.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]2[/blue]组[gold]普通[/gold]、[blue]2[/blue]组[gold]罕见[/gold]、和[blue]1[/blue]组[gold]稀有[/gold]卡牌奖励。

glitter.name: 亮片
glitter.tr: 为之后的所有卡牌奖励[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]华彩[/purple]。

glowing orb.name: 发光之球
glowing orb.tr: 在[gold]精英[/gold]战的战斗开始时，你额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

gnarled hammer.name: 扭曲锤子
gnarled hammer.tr: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择至多[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]锋利[/purple][blue]{SharpAmount:diff()}[/blue]。

golden compass.name: 黄金罗盘
golden compass.en: Upon pickup, replace the [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] Map with a single special path.
golden compass.tr: 拾起时，将第[blue]2[/blue][gold]阶段[/gold]的地图替换为一条特殊的直道。

gold-plated cables.name: 镀金缆线
gold-plated cables.en: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.
gold-plated cables.tr: 你最右侧的充能球会额外触发一次被动效果。

gorget.name: 护喉甲
gorget.en: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
gorget.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue]层[gold]覆甲[/gold]。

gremlin horn.name: 地精之角
gremlin horn.en: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
gremlin horn.tr: 每当有一名敌人死亡时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

hand drill.name: 手钻
hand drill.en: Whenever you break an enemy's [gold]Block[/gold], apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
hand drill.tr: 每当你突破敌人的[gold]格挡[/gold]时，给予其[blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue]层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

hefty tablet.name: 沉重石板
hefty tablet.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Rare cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], and add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
hefty tablet.tr: 拾起时，从[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张稀有牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]，同时将[blue]1[/blue]张[red]受伤[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

helical dart.name: 螺线飞镖
helical dart.en: Whenever you play a [gold]Shiv[/gold], gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
helical dart.tr: 你每打出一张[gold]小刀[/gold]，就在本回合获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

history course.name: 历史课
history course.en: At the start of your turn, play a copy of your last played Attack.
history course.tr: 在你的回合开始时，打出一张你上一回合最后打出的攻击牌的复制品。

horn cleat.name: 船夹板
horn cleat.en: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
horn cleat.tr: 在你的[blue]第二[/blue]回合开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ice cream.name: 冰淇淋
ice cream.en: Energy is now conserved between turns.
ice cream.tr: 多余的能量可以留到下一回合。

infused core.name: 注能核心
infused core.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold]. [gold]Lightning[/gold] deals [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] additional damage.
infused core.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]{Lightning}[/blue]个[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球额外造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点伤害。

intimidating helmet.name: 骇人头盔
intimidating helmet.en: Whenever you play a card that costs {Energy:energyIcons()} or more, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
intimidating helmet.tr: 每当你打出一张耗能大于等于{Energy:energyIcons()}的牌，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ivory tile.name: 象牙麻将牌
ivory tile.en: Whenever you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ivory tile.tr: 每当你打出一张耗能大于等于{EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()}的牌时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

jeweled mask.name: 宝石面具
jeweled mask.en: At the start of each combat, put a random Power from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this combat.
jeweled mask.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张随机能力牌从你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]，这张牌在本场战斗可以免费打出。

jewelry box.name: 珠宝盒
jewelry box.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]神化[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

joss paper.name: 金纸
joss paper.en: Every [blue]{ExhaustAmount}[/blue] times you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.

juzu bracelet.name: 佛珠手链
juzu bracelet.en: Regular enemy combats are no longer encountered in [gold]?[/gold] rooms.
juzu bracelet.tr: 你在[gold]?[/gold]房间中不会再遭遇常规战斗。

kaleidoscope.name: 万花筒
kaleidoscope.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card reward|card rewards} from other characters.
kaleidoscope.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次来自其他角色的卡牌奖励。

kifuda.name: 木札
kifuda.tr: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择至多[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌，[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]伶俐[/purple]。

kunai.name: 苦无
kunai.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
kunai.tr: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，就获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

kusarigama.name: 锁镰
kusarigama.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} in a single turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
kusarigama.tr: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，就随机对一名敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

lantern.name: 灯笼
lantern.en: Start each combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
lantern.tr: 在每场战斗的第一回合获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

large capsule.name: 巨大扭蛋
large capsule.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]{Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Add an additional [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
large capsule.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件随机[gold]遗物[/gold]。额外将一对[gold]打击[/gold]和[gold]防御[/gold]，加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

lasting candy.name: 吃不完的糖
lasting candy.en: Every other combat, your card rewards gain an additional Power.
lasting candy.tr: 每两场战斗，你的卡牌奖励就会额外包含一张能力牌。

lava lamp.name: 熔岩灯
lava lamp.en: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all card rewards if you took no damage.
lava lamp.tr: 在战斗结束时，如果你没有受到伤害，则[gold]升级[/gold]你的所有卡牌奖励。

lava rock.name: 熔岩石
lava rock.tr: 第一阶段的Boss敌人额外掉落[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件[gold]遗物[/gold]。

lead paperweight.name: 铅制镇纸
lead paperweight.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] Colorless cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
lead paperweight.tr: 拾起时，从[blue]2[/blue]张无色牌中选择[blue]1张[/blue]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

leafy poultice.name: 树叶药膏
leafy poultice.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold] and lose [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
leafy poultice.tr: 拾起时，[gold]变化[/gold]你的[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]打击[/gold]和[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]防御[/gold]，然后失去[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点最大生命。

lee's waffle.name: 李家华夫饼
lee's waffle.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] and heal all of your HP.
lee's waffle.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点，并回复所有生命。

letter opener.name: 开信刀
letter opener.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:Skill|Skills} in a single turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
letter opener.tr: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张技能牌，就对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

lizard tail.name: 蜥蜴尾巴
lizard tail.en: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your Max HP instead (works once).
lizard tail.tr: 当你的生命值将要降低至[blue]0[/blue]或以下时，回复到最大生命值的[green]{Heal}%[/green]（仅能起效一次）。

looming fruit.name: 布质果实
looming fruit.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
looming fruit.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

lord's parasol.name: 领主阳伞
lord's parasol.en: When you encounter the [gold]Merchant[/gold], immediately obtain EVERYTHING he sells.
lord's parasol.tr: 当你遇见[gold]商人[/gold]时，立刻获得他所出售的[red]所有[/red]物品。

lost coffer.name: 失物盒
lost coffer.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]1[/blue] card reward and procure [blue]1[/blue] random potion.
lost coffer.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]1[/blue]次卡牌奖励和[blue]1[/blue]瓶随机药水。

lost wisp.name: 迷失鬼火
lost wisp.en: Whenever you play a Power, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
lost wisp.tr: 你每打出一张能力牌，就对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

lucky fysh.name: 招财异鱼
lucky fysh.en: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
lucky fysh.tr: 每当你将一张卡牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]时，获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。

lunar pastry.name: 月亮糕点
lunar pastry.en: At the end of your turn, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
lunar pastry.tr: 在你的回合结束时，获得{Stars:starIcons()}。

mango.name: 芒果
mango.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
mango.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

massive scroll.name: 巨大卷轴
massive scroll.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Multiplayer Cards[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
massive scroll.tr: 拾起时，从[blue]3[/blue]张[gold]多人游戏牌[/gold]中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

maw bank.name: 巨口储蓄罐
maw bank.en: Whenever you climb a floor, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. No longer works when you spend any [gold]Gold[/gold] at the shop.
maw bank.tr: 每攀爬一层楼层，就获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。一旦在商店中花费[gold]金币[/gold]就会使其失效。

meal ticket.name: 餐券
meal ticket.en: Whenever you enter a shop room, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
meal ticket.tr: 每当你进入商店房间时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

meat cleaver.name: 切肉刀
meat cleaver.tr: 你可以在休息处进行[gold]烹饪[/gold]。

meat on the bone.name: 带骨肉
meat on the bone.en: If your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] at the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
meat on the bone.tr: 如果你在战斗结束时生命值等于或低于[blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue]，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

mercury hourglass.name: 水银沙漏
mercury hourglass.en: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
mercury hourglass.tr: 在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

metronome.name: 节拍器
metronome.en: The first time you [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{OrbCount}[/blue] [gold]Orbs[/gold] each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
metronome.tr: 每场战斗中你首次[gold]生成[/gold][blue]{OrbCount}[/blue]个[gold]充能球[/gold]时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

miniature cannon.name: 微型大炮
miniature cannon.tr: [gold]升级[/gold]的攻击牌额外造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点伤害。

miniature tent.name: 微型帐篷
miniature tent.en: You may choose any number of options at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
miniature tent.tr: 你可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]选择任意数量的选项。

mini regent.name: 迷你储君
mini regent.en: The first time you spend {singleStarIcon} each turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
mini regent.tr: 每回合你第一次花费{singleStarIcon}时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

molten egg.name: 熔火之蛋
molten egg.en: Whenever you add an Attack card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
molten egg.tr: 每当你获得[gold]攻击牌[/gold]时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

mr. struggles.name: 抱抱先生
mr. struggles.en: At the start of your turn, deal damage equal to the turn number to ALL enemies.
mr. struggles.tr: 在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成等量于当前回合数的伤害。

mummified hand.name: 干瘪之手
mummified hand.en: Whenever you play a Power, a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free to play that turn.
mummified hand.tr: 你每打出一张能力牌，[gold]手牌[/gold]中就有一张随机牌在这个回合可以免费打出。

music box.name: 音乐盒
music box.en: Create an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of the first Attack you play each turn.
music box.tr: 将你每回合打出的第一张攻击牌的一张[gold]虚无[/gold]复制品加入你的手牌。

mysterious cocoon.name: 谜之茧
mysterious cocoon.en: Upon gaining [blue]{Experience}[/blue] experience, transform [gold]Training Strike[/gold] into [gold]Impale[/gold].
mysterious cocoon.tr: 在获得[blue]{Experience}[/blue]经验后，将[gold]训练打击[/gold]变化为[gold]扎穿[/gold]。

mystic lighter.name: 神秘打火机
mystic lighter.tr: 有[gold]附魔[/gold]的攻击牌额外造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

neow's bones.name: 涅奥骨骰
neow's bones.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]Neow {Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Add [blue]{Curses}[/blue] random [red]{Curses:plural:Curse|Curses}[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow's bones.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件随机[gold]涅奥{Relics:plural:遗物|遗物}[/gold]。将[blue]{Curses}[/blue]张随机[red]{Curses:plural:诅咒|诅咒}[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

neow's sacrifice.name: 涅奥的牺牲
neow's sacrifice.en: Upon pickup, procure [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Ambergris[/gold] and add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Guilty[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow's sacrifice.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]1[/blue]瓶[gold]龙涎香[/gold]，并将[blue]1[/blue]张[red]愧疚[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

neow's talisman.name: 涅奥的护符
neow's talisman.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold].
neow's talisman.tr: 拾起时，[gold]升级[/gold]你的[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]打击[/gold]和[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]防御[/gold]。

neow's torment.name: 涅奥的苦痛
neow's torment.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Neow's Fury[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow's torment.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]涅奥之怒[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

ninja scroll.name: 忍术卷轴
ninja scroll.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Shivs}[/blue] [gold]{Shivs:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ninja scroll.tr: 每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Shivs}[/blue]张[gold]小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

nunchaku.name: 双截棍
nunchaku.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.

nutritious oyster.name: 营养牡蛎
nutritious oyster.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
nutritious oyster.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

nutritious soup.name: 营养汤
nutritious soup.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Tezcatara's Ember[/purple].
nutritious soup.tr: 拾起时，为你[gold]牌组[/gold]中的所有“[gold]打击[/gold]”[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]特兹卡塔拉的余烬[/purple]

oddly smooth stone.name: 意外光滑的石头
oddly smooth stone.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

orange dough.name: 橙色团块
orange dough.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Colorless {Cards:plural:card|cards} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
orange dough.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张随机无色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

orichalcum.name: 奥利哈钢
orichalcum.en: If you end your turn without [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
orichalcum.tr: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何[gold]格挡[/gold]，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ornamental fan.name: 精致折扇
ornamental fan.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
ornamental fan.tr: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，就获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

orrery.name: 星系仪
orrery.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次卡牌奖励

pael's blood.name: 佩尔之血
pael's blood.en: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
pael's blood.tr: 在你的回合开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌

pael's eye.name: 佩尔之眼
pael's eye.en: The first time each combat you end your turn without playing cards, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold], and take an extra turn.
pael's eye.tr: 你在每场战斗中第一次没有打出任何牌就结束回合时，[gold]消耗[/gold]所有[gold]手牌[/gold]然后进行一个额外回合。

pael's flesh.name: 佩尔之肉
pael's flesh.en: Gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, and every turn after that.
pael's flesh.tr: 从你的第[blue]3[/blue]回合开始，在回合开始时额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

pael's growth.name: 佩尔的增生组织
pael's growth.tr: 拾起时，从[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择一张牌，为其[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple]。

pael's horn.name: 佩尔之角
pael's horn.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]2[/blue]张[gold]放松[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

pael's legion.name: 佩尔的士兵
pael's legion.en: Doubles [gold]Block[/gold] gained from a card, then goes to sleep for [blue]{Turns}[/blue] {Turns:plural:turn|turns}.
pael's legion.tr: 将你从一张卡牌中获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]翻倍，然后此遗物会休眠[blue]{Turns}[/blue]回合。

pael's tears.name: 佩尔之泪
pael's tears.en: If you end your turn with unspent {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
pael's tears.tr: 如果你在拥有未花费的{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}情况下结束回合，则下个回合额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

pael's tooth.name: 佩尔之牙

pael's wing.name: 佩尔之翼
pael's wing.en: You may sacrifice card rewards to Pael. Every {Sacrifices:plural:sacrifice|[blue]{}[/blue] sacrifices}, obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold].
pael's wing.tr: 你可以将你的卡牌奖励献祭给佩尔。每献祭[blue]{Sacrifices}[/blue]次，就能获得一件[gold]遗物[/gold]。

pantograph.name: 缩放仪
pantograph.en: At the start of each [gold]Boss[/gold] combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.

paper krane.name: 纸鹤
paper krane.en: Enemies with [gold]Weak[/gold] deal [blue]40%[/blue] less damage to you rather than [blue]25%[/blue].
paper krane.tr: 有[gold]虚弱[/gold]状态的敌人造成的伤害降低[blue]40%[/blue]而非[blue]25%[/blue]。

paper phrog.name: 纸蛙
paper phrog.en: Enemies with [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] take [blue]75%[/blue] more damage rather than [blue]50%[/blue].
paper phrog.tr: 有[gold]易伤[/gold]状态的敌人受到的伤害增加[blue]75%[/blue]而非[blue]50%[/blue]。

parrying shield.name: 招架盾
parrying shield.en: If you end a turn with at least [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
parrying shield.tr: 如果你在回合结束时拥有至少[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]，则对随机敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

pear.name: 梨子
pear.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
pear.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

pen nib.name: 钢笔尖
pen nib.en: Every [blue]10th[/blue] Attack you play deals double damage.
pen nib.tr: 你每打出的第[blue]10[/blue]张攻击牌将会造成双倍伤害。

permafrost.name: 永冻冰晶
permafrost.en: The first time you play a Power each combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
permafrost.tr: 当你在战斗中第一次打出能力牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

petrified toad.name: 石化蟾蜍
petrified toad.en: At the start of each combat, procure a [gold]Potion-Shaped Rock[/gold].
petrified toad.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得一瓶[gold]药水形状的石头[/gold]

phial holster.name: 药瓶皮套
phial holster.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion {PotionSlots:plural:slot|slots} and procure [blue]{Potions}[/blue] random [gold]{Potions:plural:Potion|Potions}[/gold].
phial holster.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue]个药水栏位并获得[blue]{Potions}[/blue]瓶随机[gold]药水[/gold]。

philosopher's stone.name: 贤者之石
philosopher's stone.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. ALL enemies start combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
philosopher's stone.tr: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。所有敌人初始获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

phylactery unbound.name: 无界命匣
phylactery unbound.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{StartOfCombat}[/blue]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{StartOfTurn}[/blue].
phylactery unbound.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]{StartOfCombat}[/blue]。在你的回合开始时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]{StartOfTurn}[/blue]。

planisphere.name: 活动星图
planisphere.en: Whenever you enter a [gold]?[/gold] room, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
planisphere.tr: 每当你进入[gold]？[/gold]房间的时候，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

pocketwatch.name: 怀表
pocketwatch.en: Whenever you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer {CardThreshold:plural:card|cards} during your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
pocketwatch.tr: 当你在本回合打出的牌少于等于[blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue]张时，则在你的下个回合开始时额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

potion belt.name: 药水腰带
potion belt.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue]个药水栏位。

power cell.name: 能量电池
power cell.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] zero-cost cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
power cell.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张耗能为0的卡牌从你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

prayer wheel.name: 转经轮
prayer wheel.en: Normal enemies drop an additional card reward.
prayer wheel.tr: 普通敌人额外掉落一次卡牌奖励。

precarious shears.name: 松动羊毛剪
precarious shears.en: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
precarious shears.tr: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌并失去[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点生命。

precise scissors.name: 精准剪刀
precise scissors.tr: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

preserved fog.name: 腌制活雾
preserved fog.en: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
preserved fog.tr: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。将一张[red]愚行[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

prismatic gem.name: 棱彩宝石
prismatic gem.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Card rewards now contain cards from other colors.
prismatic gem.tr: 在每个回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。卡牌奖励现在会包含其他颜色的卡牌。

pumpkin candle.name: 南瓜蜡烛
pumpkin candle.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Extinguishes after [blue]{CombatCount}[/blue] combats. Can be [gold]Kindled[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
pumpkin candle.tr: 在每个回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。这件遗物会在[blue]{CombatCount}[/blue]场战斗后熄灭。可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]为其[gold]添火[/gold]。

punch dagger.name: 拳刃
punch dagger.tr: 拾起时，选择一张攻击牌为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]动量[/purple][blue]{Momentum}[/blue]。

radiant pearl.name: 发光珍珠
radiant pearl.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Luminesce|Luminesces}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
radiant pearl.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]冷光[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

rainbow ring.name: 彩虹戒指
rainbow ring.en: The first time you play an Attack, Skill, and Power each turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
rainbow ring.tr: 每回合，你第一次打出攻击牌、技能牌和能力牌各一张时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

razor tooth.name: 剃刀牙
razor tooth.en: Every time you play an Attack or Skill, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
razor tooth.tr: 你打出攻击牌和技能牌时，将其在本场战斗内[gold]升级[/gold]。

red mask.name: 红面具
red mask.en: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
red mask.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，给于所有敌人[blue]{WeakPower}[/blue]层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

red skull.name: 红头骨
red skull.en: While your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], you have [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold].
red skull.tr: 当你的生命值低于或等于[blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue]时，你额外获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]

red vine tea.name: 赤藤茶
red vine tea.en: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
red vine tea.tr: 在你接下来的[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

regalite.name: 君王矿石
regalite.en: The first time you create a card each turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
regalite.tr: 每回合你第一次生成一张牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

regal pillow.name: 皇家枕头
regal pillow.en: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], heal an additional [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.

reptile trinket.name: 爬行动物饰品
reptile trinket.en: Whenever you use a potion, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
reptile trinket.tr: 当你使用药水时，在本回合获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue][gold]力量[/gold]。

ringing triangle.name: 三角铃鼓
ringing triangle.en: [gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] on the first turn of combat.
ringing triangle.tr: 在每场战斗的第一回合[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

ring of the drake.name: 长蛇戒指
ring of the drake.en: At the start of your first {Turns:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ring of the drake.tr: 在战斗开始时的前[blue]{Turns}[/blue]个回合，你额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

ring of the snake.name: 蛇之戒指
ring of the snake.en: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ring of the snake.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

ripple basin.name: 波纹水盆
ripple basin.en: If you did not play any Attacks during your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
ripple basin.tr: 如果你在本回合中没有打出过攻击牌，则获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

royal poison.name: 王室猛毒
royal poison.en: At the start of each combat, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
royal poison.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，失去[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点生命。

royal stamp.name: 王室印章
royal stamp.en: Upon pickup, choose an Attack or Skill in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to [gold]Enchant[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
royal stamp.tr: 拾起时，从[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择一张攻击牌或技能牌，为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]{Enchantment}[/purple]。

ruined helmet.name: 损毁头盔
ruined helmet.en: The first time you gain [gold]Strength[/gold] each combat, double the amount gained.
ruined helmet.tr: 你在每场战斗中第一次获得的[gold]力量[/gold]值翻倍。

runic capacitor.name: 符文电容器
runic capacitor.en: Start each combat with [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] additional [gold]Orb Slots[/gold].
runic capacitor.tr: 每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{Repeat}[/blue]个额外[gold]充能球栏位[/gold]。

runic pyramid.name: 符文金字塔
runic pyramid.en: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
runic pyramid.tr: 你在回合结束时不再自动丢弃所有[gold]手牌[/gold]。

sai.name: 钗
sai.en: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
sai.tr: 在你的回合开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

screaming flagon.name: 尖叫酒壶
screaming flagon.en: If you end your turn with no cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
screaming flagon.tr: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何[gold]手牌[/gold]，则对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

scroll boxes.name: 卷轴箱
scroll boxes.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] packs of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
scroll boxes.tr: 拾起时，从[blue]2[/blue]个卡牌包中选择[blue]1[/blue]包加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

seal of gold.name: 黄金印
seal of gold.en: At the start of your turn, spend [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
seal of gold.tr: 在你的回合开始时，花费[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]来获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

sea glass.name: 海玻璃
sea glass.en: See [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from {Character.StringValue:cond:[gold]{}[/gold]|another character}. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
sea glass.tr: 查看[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张来自{Character.StringValue:cond:[gold]{}[/gold]|其他角色}的牌。从中选择任意数量的卡牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

self-forming clay.name: 自成型黏土
self-forming clay.en: Whenever you lose HP in combat, gain [blue]{BlockNextTurn}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] next turn.
self-forming clay.tr: 每当你在战斗中失去生命，就在下回合获得[blue]{BlockNextTurn}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

sere talon.name: 原初之爪
sere talon.en: Upon pickup, lose [blue]9[/blue] Max HP. Add [blue]{Wishes}[/blue] [purple]Wishes[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
sere talon.tr: 拾起时，失去[blue]9[/blue]点最大生命值，将[blue]{Wishes}[/blue]张[purple]许愿[/purple]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

shovel.name: 铲子
shovel.en: You can now dig at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] to obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].
shovel.tr: 现在你可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]挖掘[gold]遗物[/gold]。

shuriken.name: 手里剑
shuriken.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
shuriken.tr: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

silken tress.name: 华美发束
silken tress.en: Upon pickup, lose all [gold]Gold[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in your first card reward with [purple]Glam[/purple].
silken tress.tr: 拾起时，失去所有[gold]金币[/gold]。为你的第一次卡牌奖励中的所有牌[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]华彩[/purple]。

silver crucible.name: 白银熔炉
silver crucible.en: The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card rewards you see are [gold]Upgraded[/gold]. The first Treasure Chest you open is [red]empty[/red].
silver crucible.tr: 你遇到的前[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次卡牌奖励将是被[gold]升级[/gold]过的。你打开的第一个宝箱将是[red]空的[/red]

sling of courage.name: 勇气投石索
sling of courage.tr: 在与[gold]精英[/gold]敌人战斗时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

small capsule.name: 小型扭蛋
small capsule.tr: 拾起时，获得一件随机[gold]遗物[/gold]。

snecko eye.name: 异蛇之眼
snecko eye.en: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Start each combat [red]Confused[/red].
snecko eye.tr: 每回合多抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。每场战斗开始时获得[red]混乱[/red]效果。

snecko skull.name: 异蛇头骨
snecko skull.en: Whenever you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], apply an additional [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
snecko skull.tr: 每当你给予敌人[gold]中毒[/gold]时，所给予的[gold]中毒[/gold]层数增加[blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue]层。

sozu.name: 添水
sozu.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You can no longer obtain [gold]Potions[/gold].
sozu.tr: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。你无法再获得[gold]药水[/gold]。

sparkling rouge.name: 闪亮口红
sparkling rouge.en: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
sparkling rouge.tr: 在你的第[blue]3[/blue]回合开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

spiked gauntlets.name: 带刺手甲
spiked gauntlets.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Powers cost [blue]1[/blue] more {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
spiked gauntlets.tr: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。能力牌的耗能增加[blue]1[/blue]{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

stone calendar.name: 历石
stone calendar.en: At the end of turn [blue]{DamageTurn}[/blue], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
stone calendar.tr: 在第[blue]{DamageTurn}[/blue]回合结束时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

stone cracker.name: 碎石钻
stone cracker.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] for the rest of combat.
stone cracker.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，在本场战斗中随机[gold]升级[/gold]你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

stone humidifier.name: 石炉加湿器
stone humidifier.en: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold] at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
stone humidifier.tr: 每当你在[gold]休息处[/gold][gold]休息[/gold]时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点。

storybook.name: 故事书
storybook.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Brightest Flame[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
storybook.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]至亮之焰[/gold]添加到你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中。

strawberry.name: 草莓
strawberry.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
strawberry.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

strike dummy.name: 打击木偶
strike dummy.tr: 名字中有“打击”的卡牌造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点额外伤害。

sturdy clamp.name: 坚固钳子
sturdy clamp.tr: 可以跨回合保留最多[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

sword of jade.name: 玉之剑
sword of jade.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

sword of stone.name: 石之剑
sword of stone.en: Transforms into a powerful [gold]Relic[/gold] after defeating [blue]{Elites}[/blue] [gold]{Elites:plural:Elite|Elites}[/gold].
sword of stone.tr: 在击败[blue]{Elites}[/blue]名[gold]精英[/gold]敌人之后将变化为一件强力[gold]遗物[/gold]。

symbiotic virus.name: 共生病毒
symbiotic virus.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Dark}[/blue] [gold]Dark[/gold].
symbiotic virus.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]{Dark}[/blue]个[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球。

tanx's whistle.name: 坦克斯的哨子
tanx's whistle.tr: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]吹哨[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

tea of discourtesy.name: 无礼之茶
tea of discourtesy.en: At the start of the next combat, shuffle [blue]{DazedCount}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
tea of discourtesy.tr: 在下一场战斗开始时，将[blue]{DazedCount}[/blue]张[gold]晕眩[/gold]放入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

the abacus.name: 算盘
the abacus.en: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
the abacus.tr: 你每次将[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]洗牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

the boot.name: 发条靴
the boot.en: Whenever you would deal [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue].
the boot.tr: 每当你造成小于等于[blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue]点未被格挡的攻击伤害时，将伤害提升为[blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue]。

the courier.name: 送货员
the courier.en: The merchant no longer runs out of cards, relics, or potions and his prices are reduced by [blue]{Discount}%[/blue].
the courier.tr: 商人的卡牌、遗物和药水不再会卖光，并且所有商品打折[blue]{Discount}%[/blue]。

throwing axe.name: 投斧
throwing axe.en: The first card you play each combat is played an extra time.
throwing axe.tr: 你在每场战斗中打出的第一张牌会多打出一次。

tingsha.name: 铜钹
tingsha.en: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy for each card discarded.
tingsha.tr: 你每在你的回合丢弃一张牌，就对一名随机敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

tiny mailbox.name: 小邮箱
tiny mailbox.tr: 每当你[gold]休息[/gold]时，获得[blue]2[/blue]瓶随机[gold]药水[/gold]。

toasty mittens.name: 烘焙手套
toasty mittens.en: At the start of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] and gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
toasty mittens.tr: 在你的回合开始时，[gold]消耗[/gold]你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的[blue]1[/blue]张牌并获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

toolbox.name: 工具箱
toolbox.en: At the start of each combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
toolbox.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，从[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张随机无色牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

touch of orobas.name: 欧洛巴斯之触
touch of orobas.en: Upon pickup, replace {StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold] with [gold]{UpgradedRelic}[/gold]|your starter [gold]Relic[/gold] with an [gold]Ancient[/gold] version}.
touch of orobas.tr: 拾起时，将{StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold]替换为[gold]{UpgradedRelic}[/gold]|你的初始[gold]遗物[/gold]替换为[gold]先古[/gold]版本}。

tough bandages.name: 结实绷带
tough bandages.en: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
tough bandages.tr: 你每在你的回合丢弃一张牌，就获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

toxic egg.name: 毒素之蛋
toxic egg.en: Whenever you add a Skill into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
toxic egg.tr: 每当你获得[gold]技能牌[/gold]时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

toy box.name: 玩具盒
toy box.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] [gold]Wax {Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] {Combats:plural:combat|combats}, your left-most [gold]Wax Relic[/gold] will melt away.
toy box.tr: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件[gold]蜡制遗物[/gold]。每经过[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗，你最左侧的[gold]蜡制遗物[/gold]将会融化。

tri-boomerang.name: 三刃回旋镖
tri-boomerang.tr: 从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌。为这些牌[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]本能[/purple]。

tungsten rod.name: 钨合金棍
tungsten rod.en: Whenever you would lose HP, lose [blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue] less.
tungsten rod.tr: 你每次失去生命时，减少失去的生命值[blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue]点。

tuning fork.name: 音叉
tuning fork.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
tuning fork.tr: 你每打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张技能牌，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

twisted funnel.name: 扭曲漏斗
twisted funnel.en: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
twisted funnel.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，给予所有敌人[blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue]层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

unceasing top.name: 不休陀螺
unceasing top.en: Whenever you have no cards in [gold]Hand[/gold] during your turn, draw a card.
unceasing top.tr: 在你的回合，当你没有[gold]手牌[/gold]时，抽一张牌。

undying sigil.name: 不死符文
undying sigil.en: Enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP deal [blue]50%[/blue] less damage.
undying sigil.tr: 当敌人的[gold]灾厄[/gold]层数大于等于其生命值时，它造成的伤害降低[blue]50%[/blue]。

unsettling lamp.name: 不安油灯
unsettling lamp.en: Each combat, the first time you play a card that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] an enemy, double its effect.
unsettling lamp.tr: 你在每场战斗中第一次打出能给予敌人[gold]负面状态[/gold]的牌时，将其效果翻倍。

vajra.name: 金刚杵
vajra.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

vambrace.name: 臂甲
vambrace.en: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each combat, double the amount gained.
vambrace.tr: 每场战斗中，你第一次从卡牌中获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]值翻倍。

velvet choker.name: 天鹅绒颈圈
velvet choker.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} per turn.
velvet choker.tr: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。你每回合不能打出超过[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

venerable tea set.name: 古茶具套装
venerable tea set.en: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
venerable tea set.tr: 到达[gold]休息处[/gold]后的下一场战斗开始时额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

very hot cocoa.name: 烫嘴可可
very hot cocoa.en: Start each combat with an additional [blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue].
very hot cocoa.tr: 在每场战斗的第一回合额外获得[blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue]。

vexing puzzlebox.name: 烦人机关盒
vexing puzzlebox.en: At the start of each combat, add a random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
vexing puzzlebox.tr: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张随机卡牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

vine bracelet.name: 藤蔓手镯
vine bracelet.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
vine bracelet.tr: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

vitruvian minion.name: 维特鲁威仆从
vitruvian minion.en: Cards containing “Minion” deal double damage and gain double [gold]Block[/gold].
vitruvian minion.tr: 名字中有“仆从”的卡牌造成双倍的伤害与[gold]格挡[/gold]。

war hammer.name: 战锤
war hammer.tr: 每当你击败一名[gold]精英[/gold]敌人的时候，随机[gold]升级[/gold][blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

whispering earring.name: 低语耳环
whispering earring.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. [red]Vakuu plays your first turn for you.[/red]
whispering earring.tr: 在每个回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。[red]瓦库将接管你的第一回合。[/red]

white beast statue.name: 白兽雕像
white beast statue.tr: 战斗结束后必定掉落[gold]药水[/gold]。

white star.name: 白星
white star.tr: [gold]精英[/gold]敌人额外掉落一次[gold]稀有[/gold]卡牌奖励。

winged boots.name: 羽翼之靴
winged boots.en: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] times.
winged boots.tr: 你在选择下一层的房间时有[blue]{Rooms}[/blue]次机会可以无视当前的路线。

wing charm.name: 羽翼护符
wing charm.en: A random card in each card reward is [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Swift[/purple] [blue]{SwiftAmount}[/blue].
wing charm.tr: 每次卡牌奖励中，都会有随机一张牌被[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]迅捷[/purple][blue]{SwiftAmount}[/blue]。

wongo's mystery ticket.name: 旺购神秘券
wongo's mystery ticket.tr: 在[blue]{RemainingCombats}[/blue]场战斗后，获得随机[blue]{Repeat}[/blue]件[gold]遗物[/gold]。

ambergris.name: 龙涎香
ambergris.en: Heal for [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP. If used in combat, take an extra turn.
ambergris.tr: 回复你最大生命值的[green]{HealPercent}%[/green]。在战斗中使用时，额外进行一个回合。

ashwater.name: 灰水
ashwater.en: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].

attack potion.name: 攻击药水
attack potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Attack cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
attack potion.tr: 从[blue]3[/blue]张随机攻击牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

beetle juice.name: 甲虫汁
beetle juice.en: Enemy's attacks deal [blue]{DamageDecrease}%[/blue] less damage {Repeat:plural:next turn|for the next [blue]{}[/blue] turns}.
beetle juice.tr: 敌人的攻击在下[blue]{Repeat}[/blue]个回合中造成的伤害减少[blue]{DamageDecrease}%[/blue]。

blessing of the forge.name: 熔炉的祝福
blessing of the forge.en: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] for the rest of combat.
blessing of the forge.tr: 在本场战斗中[gold]升级[/gold]你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的所有牌。

blood potion.name: 鲜血药水
blood potion.en: Heal for [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP.

bottled potential.name: 瓶装潜能
bottled potential.en: Shuffle ALL your cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
bottled potential.tr: 将你的所有牌洗入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

clarity extract.name: 明晰提取物
clarity extract.en: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. At the start of your next {ClarityPower:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
clarity extract.tr: 抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。在你的下[blue]{ClarityPower}[/blue]个回合开始时，额外抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

colorless potion.name: 无色药水
colorless potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Colorless cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
colorless potion.tr: 从[blue]3[/blue]张随机无色牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

cosmic concoction.name: 宇宙药剂
cosmic concoction.tr: 将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]升级[/gold]的无色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

deprecated potion.name: 废弃药水
deprecated potion.en: This potion has been removed from the game.
deprecated potion.tr: 这瓶药水已经从游戏中移除。

distilled chaos.name: 精炼混沌
distilled chaos.en: Play the top [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].

droplet of precognition.name: 预知之滴
droplet of precognition.en: Choose a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and add it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
droplet of precognition.tr: 选择你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的一张牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

duplicator.name: 复制药水
duplicator.en: This turn, your next card is played an extra time.
duplicator.tr: 本回合，你打出的下一张牌会额外打出一次。

entropic brew.name: 混沌药水
entropic brew.en: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.
entropic brew.tr: 在所有空药水栏位中获得随机药水。

essence of darkness.name: 黑暗精华
essence of darkness.en: [gold]Channel[/gold] a [gold]Dark[/gold] for each of your [gold]Orb Slots[/gold].
essence of darkness.tr: [gold]生成[/gold]你[gold]充能球栏位[/gold]数量个[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球。

explosive ampoule.name: 爆炸安瓿
explosive ampoule.tr: 对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

fairy in a bottle.name: 瓶中精灵
fairy in a bottle.en: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], instead this potion is discarded and you heal to [blue]30%[/blue] of your Max HP.
fairy in a bottle.tr: 当你的生命值将被减少至[blue]0[/blue]或以下时，改为丢弃这瓶药水，然后将你回复到你最大生命值的[blue]30%[/blue]。

flex potion.name: 肌肉药水
flex potion.en: Gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the end of your turn, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
flex potion.tr: 获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。在你的这个回合结束时，失去[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

foul potion.name: 污浊药水
foul potion.en:
Deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL players and enemies.
Can be thrown at the [gold]Merchant[/gold] for [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] instead.
foul potion.tr:
对所有玩家和敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。
也可以投掷给[gold]商人[/gold]换取[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。

gambler's brew.name: 赌徒特酿
gambler's brew.en: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.
gambler's brew.tr: 丢弃任意张牌，然后抽相同数量的牌。

gigantification potion.name: 超巨化药水
gigantification potion.en: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.
gigantification potion.tr: 你打出的下一张攻击牌将会造成三倍伤害。

liquid memories.name: 液态记忆
liquid memories.en: Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
liquid memories.tr: 将你[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]中的一张牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

orobic acid.name: 欧洛巴斯之酸
orobic acid.en: Add a random Attack, Skill, and Power into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They're free to play this turn.
orobic acid.tr: 往你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中加入一张随机攻击牌、一张随机技能牌和一张随机能力牌。这些牌在本回合免费。

potion of binding.name: 缚魂药水
potion of binding.tr: 给予所有敌人[blue]{WeakPower:diff()}[/blue]层[gold]虚弱[/gold]和[blue]{VulnerablePower:diff()}[/blue]层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

powdered demise.name: 消亡粉末
powdered demise.en: Enemy loses [blue]{Demise}[/blue] HP at the end of each of its turns.
powdered demise.tr: 敌人在自身的每个回合结束时，失去[blue]{Demise}[/blue]点生命。

power potion.name: 能力药水
power potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Power cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
power potion.tr: 从[blue]3[/blue]张随机能力牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

radiant tincture.name: 明耀酊剂
radiant tincture.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Gain an additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your next [blue]{RadiancePower}[/blue] {RadiancePower:plural:turn|turns}.
radiant tincture.tr: 获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。在你的下[blue]{RadiancePower}[/blue]个回合开始时，额外获得{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

shackling potion.name: 镣铐药水
shackling potion.tr: 所有敌人在这个回合失去[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

ship in a bottle.name: 瓶中船
ship in a bottle.tr: 获得[blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。在下个回合开始时获得[blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

skill potion.name: 技能药水
skill potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Skill cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
skill potion.tr: 从[blue]3[/blue]张随机技能牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

snecko oil.name: 异蛇之油
snecko oil.en: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn.
snecko oil.tr: 抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。在本回合随机化你[gold]手牌[/gold]中所有牌的耗能。

soldier's stew.name: 士兵炖汤
soldier's stew.en: All cards containing [gold]Strike[/gold] gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Replay[/gold] this combat.
soldier's stew.tr: 在本场战斗中，所有名字中有“[gold]打击[/gold]”的牌获得[gold]重放[/gold]：[blue]1[/blue]。

speed potion.name: 速度药水
speed potion.en: Gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. At the end of your turn, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
speed potion.tr: 获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。在你的这个回合结束时，失去[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

touch of insanity.name: 癫狂之触
touch of insanity.en: Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this combat.
touch of insanity.tr: 选择你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的一张牌，使其在本场战斗可以免费打出。

clone.name: 克隆
clone.en: This card can be duplicated at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
clone.tr: 这张牌能在[gold]休息处[/gold]被复制。

corrupted.name: 腐化
corrupted.en: Deal [blue]50%[/blue] more damage, but lose [blue]2[/blue] HP.
corrupted.tr: 造成的伤害增加[blue]50%[/blue]，但会失去[blue]2[/blue]生命。

deprecated.name: 弃用
deprecated.en: This enchantment has been removed from the game.
deprecated.tr: 这个附魔已经从游戏中被移除。

glam.name: 华彩
glam.en: This card has [gold]Replay[/gold] once per combat.
glam.tr: 这张牌每场战斗能够[gold]重放[/gold]一次。

goopy.name: 黏糊
goopy.en: This card gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. When played, permanently increase this card's [gold]Block[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue].
goopy.tr: 这张牌获得[gold]消耗[/gold]。当被打出时，这张牌的[gold]格挡[/gold]值永久增加[blue]1[/blue]点。

imbued.name: 注能
imbued.en: This card is played automatically at the start of each combat.
imbued.tr: 这张牌在每场战斗开始时自动打出。

instinct.name: 本能
instinct.en: This card's attack damage is doubled.
instinct.tr: 这张牌的攻击伤害翻倍。

momentum.name: 动量
momentum.en: Increase this card's attack damage by [blue]{Amount}[/blue] this combat when played.
momentum.tr: 在本场战斗中，每次打出就增加这张牌的攻击伤害[blue]{Amount}[/blue]点。

nimble.name: 灵巧
nimble.en: Increases [gold]Block[/gold] gained from this card by [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
nimble.tr: 这张牌获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]值增加[blue]{Amount}[/blue]点。

perfect fit.name: 完美契合
perfect fit.en: Whenever this would be shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], place it on the top instead.
perfect fit.tr: 每当这张牌要被洗入[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]时，将其放在抽牌堆顶。

royally approved.name: 王室认证
royally approved.tr: 这张牌拥有[gold]固有[/gold]和[gold]保留[/gold]。

sharp.name: 锋利
sharp.en: Increases damage on this card by [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
sharp.tr: 这张牌上的伤害值增加[blue]{Amount}[/blue]点。

slither.name: 蛇行
slither.en: When you draw this card, randomize its cost from [blue]0[/blue] to [blue]3[/blue].
slither.tr: 当你抽到这张牌时，使其费用在[blue]0[/blue]到[blue]3[/blue]之间随机变化。

slumbering essence.name: 沉眠精华
slumbering essence.en: If this card is in your hand at the end of turn, reduce its cost by [blue]1[/blue] until it is played.
slumbering essence.tr: 回合结束时，如果这张牌在你的手牌中，则将其费用降低[blue]1[/blue]点，直到其被打出。

sown.name: 播种
sown.en: The first time you play this card each combat, gain {Amount:energyIcons()}.
sown.tr: 你在每场战斗中第一次打出这张牌时，获得{Amount:energyIcons()}。

swift.name: 迅速
swift.en: The first time you play this card, draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
swift.tr: 你第一次打出这张牌时，抽[blue]{Amount}[/blue]张牌。

tezcatara's ember.name: 特兹卡塔拉的余烬
tezcatara's ember.en: Costs [blue]0[/blue], deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage, and gains [gold]Eternal[/gold].
tezcatara's ember.tr: 费用为[blue]0[/blue]，造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue] 点额外伤害，且获得[gold]永恒[/gold]。

vigorous.name: 活力
vigorous.en: The first time this card is played, it deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional damage.
vigorous.tr: 第一次打出这张牌时，造成[blue]{Amount}[/blue]点额外伤害。

encounters.two gremlins in a trenchcoat: 穿着一件大衣的两只地精
